name: Why is proper drying important before repainting water-damaged areas?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper drying important before repainting water-damaged areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper drying is paramount before repainting water-damaged areas to prevent several critical issues. If moisture remains trapped behind new paint, it can lead to peeling, bubbling, and adhesion problems as the moisture tries to escape. More importantly, residual moisture creates an ideal environment for mold and mildew growth, which can cause health issues and further damage to structural components. Ensuring the area is completely dry, often confirmed with moisture meters by professionals, is a non-negotiable step for a long-lasting and healthy repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper drying prevents paint peeling, bubbling, and crucially, mold growth, ensuring a lasting repair and healthy environment.
